title: OTP seed: one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 6 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: one character (1) outside the RFC 3548 Base32 alphabet the Key URI format requires. Twin of "OTP seed: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
